method: Standalone current-source deep dive plus fresh retest. Current municipal product pages, current 2026 policy, current 2026 fee regulation and recent 2026 permit decisions were cross-checked.

legalFramework.kamerbewoningAndSplitting: Omgevingsplan prohibits changing a dwelling to kamerbewoning or multiple dwellings without omgevingsvergunning. Current assessment policy is Beleidsregels kamerbewoning en woningsplitsing Eindhoven 2026, effective 2026-01-01.
legalFramework.thirtyMetreRule: Outside listed exceptions, permit is refused when the property is wholly/partly within or touched by a 30-metre circle measured from the centre point of an existing legal room-rental/split property or an earlier pending qualifying application. The rule does not apply in the centre, specified flats/complexes, legal room additions, transition cases and qualifying upper dwellings over non-residential functions outside op-slot areas; a liveability test still applies.
legalFramework.kamerQuality: For room rental, rooms average at least 14 m2 without qualifying shared living/kitchen space, or average at least 10 m2 with shared living room >=7.5 m2 plus kitchen >=5 m2 or shared living-kitchen >=12.5 m2. Max one person per room.
legalFramework.otherAssessment: Liveability, privacy, sound mitigation, parking and other housing-quality requirements apply according to the policy and case.
legalFramework.transition2026: From 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31, specified long-existing room-rental and split situations in original op-slot areas can seek legalization if evidence meets the policy dates/conditions. New room rental and new splitting remain prohibited in op-slot areas.
legalFramework.opkoopbescherming: For qualifying existing dwellings bought after 2022-04-01 with WOZ below EUR 355000 in designated neighbourhoods, letting is generally prohibited without a permit unless an exception applies. Since 2024 new-build dwellings are no longer covered by opkoopbescherming.

kamerverhuur.permit: omgevingsvergunning for use contrary to Omgevingsplan
requiredDocuments: site drawing showing at least two streets, e.g. cadastral map
existing legal floor plans with room functions
new floor plans with room numbers/functions and shared facilities
drawing of on-site parking where present
result of municipal parking-standard calculation tool
kamerverhuur.decisionPeriod: usually 8 weeks; one extension of 6 weeks possible; incomplete-application supplementation suspends the period
kamerverhuur.fees: 2026 fee is activity/calculation dependent; current Legesverordening 2026 must be applied rather than inventing one flat amount

woningsplitsing.permit: omgevingsvergunning; one application can combine deviation/use and building activities
requiredDocuments: site drawing showing at least two streets
existing legal floor plans with room functions
new floor plans identifying each new dwelling/studio and internal functions
drawing of on-site parking where present
woningsplitsing.decisionPeriod: usually 8 weeks; one extension of 6 weeks possible; supplementation suspends the period
woningsplitsing.fees: 2026 fee is calculated from the applicable Omgevingswet activities/current tariff table; building-cost reference table includes woningsplitsing at EUR 231 per m2 as a cost-reference category, not automatically the final permit fee

opkoopbescherming.authentication: DigiD or eHerkenning; separate no-login form available for applicants without either credential or abroad
opkoopbescherming.exceptions: close family; inseparable business-premises dwelling; after at least one year owner occupation, temporary non-tourist letting for max one year; possible hardship clause

freshRetestEvidence.recent2026Decisions: Multiple June 2026 municipal permit decisions for transition-regime room rental confirm actual use of the 2026 regime.
freshRetestEvidence.interpretation: These decisions corroborate the current product-page document requirements but are not used to invent a universal extra attachment list.

remaining: address/BAG/geometry calculation for 30-metre circle, centre/rest/op-slot classification and nearby legal/pending room-rental/splitting properties
calculate exact 2026 omgevingsvergunning fee for a concrete project because the tariff is activity/project composed
for opkoopbescherming: address/neighbourhood eligibility and exception-specific evidence from the live form
closureAssessment: Standalone generic legal, policy, application-document and procedure research is substantially complete. Remaining work is legitimately case/address/geometry dependent or requires project-specific fee calculation; these should not block batch-level legal research closure.
